description:

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (React + Python)
description:
Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Today our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity and driven by responsibility. We’re optimists for change and we help clients initiate, navigate and benefit from transformation. We believe optimism is a force multiplier, helping clients to mitigate downside and maximize opportunity. 
With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our 3,000 consultants serve clients worldwide from 48 locations in 19 countries. Our expertise delivers results. Our optimism transforms outcomes. 

Our Mumbai office was launched in 2024, marking an exciting new chapter for us. We’re building the team with people who are eager to shape something from the ground up — combining the agility and entrepreneurial energy of a startup with the backing and reach of a global brand.

We are looking for a skilled Senior Full Stack Engineer (React + Python) for our Mumbai location. This role involves developing scalable, high-performing web applications for our AI-powered SaaS solutions. You will work across frontend and backend systems, building intuitive user interfaces using React and robust backend services using Python, while collaborating closely with product, design, DevOps, and engineering teams. 
Key Responsibilities:
Frontend Development: Develop and optimize responsive, user-friendly interfaces using ReactJS, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. Ensure the technical feasibility of UI/UX designs. 
Backend Development: Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and APIs using Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Django, or Flask. 
API Development & Integration: Build, maintain, and optimize RESTful APIs; integrate frontend applications with backend services, databases, and third-party platforms. 
Database Management: Work with SQL and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL and MongoDB, ensuring data integrity, performance, and scalability. 
Performance Optimization: Improve frontend rendering, application responsiveness, backend performance, and API reliability. 
Code Integrity: Maintain and improve code quality through unit testing, integration testing, automation, documentation, and code reviews. 
Containerization & Cloud Deployment: Use Docker and Kubernetes to deploy and manage containerized applications. Work with GCP, AWS, or Azure for cloud deployment and application management. 
Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Utilize Terraform and Helm to manage cloud infrastructure and ensure scalable, efficient deployment environments. 
CI/CD Management: Contribute to continuous integration and deployment processes, including test automation, build artifact creation, and application releases.

3–6 years of software development experience, with hands-on experience in full stack development using ReactJS and Python. 
Skills 
- Strong expertise in ReactJS, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. 

- Proficiency in Python and backend frameworks such as FastAPI, Django, or Flask. 

- Experience with REST APIs; familiarity with GraphQL is a plus. 

- Experience with frontend state management solutions such as Redux, Context API, React Query, or Zustand. 

- Database management experience with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or similar SQL/NoSQL databases. 

- Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and microservices architecture. 

- Hands-on experience deploying and managing applications using GCP, AWS, or Azure. 

- Infrastructure as Code (IaC) skills with Terraform and Helm. 

- Understanding of unit testing, API testing, code reviews, and secure coding practices. 

- Familiarity with Figma, responsive design, accessibility standards, and cross-browser compatibility.

Education 
Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

What We Offer 
- Opportunity to lead cutting-edge AI projects in a global consulting environment. 

- Leadership development programs and training sessions at our global centers. 

- A dynamic and collaborative team environment with diverse projects. 

Position based in Mumbai (onsite)

title: Staff Backend Engineer, Performance Enablement
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Staff Backend Engineer in GitLab's Performance Enablement group, you'll define and build the self-serve platform that lets GitLab engineering teams own their performance. You'll give internal teams the tooling and guidance to run performance tests, analyze results, track trends, and meet their own performance requirements throughout the development lifecycle. We're a platform, not a consulting service: we build capabilities that teams use independently to deliver a reliable, performant GitLab to customers. In this hands-on technical leadership role, you'll work with the Engineering Manager to shape a multi-quarter vision and roadmap, bringing your performance engineering expertise to influence teams across research and development (R&D).

Some examples of our projects in Performance Enablement:

- Building reusable component-level testing, load testing, performance analysis, trend visibility, and artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted engineering skills

- Enabling teams to test performance throughout the development lifecycle, from local development and continuous integration (CI) workflows through pre-release validation, including modular feature teams' own workflows

What you’ll do

- Define the team's technical vision and multi-quarter roadmap with the Engineering Manager, identify opportunities for impact across R&D, and advocate for technical priorities with stakeholders.

- Design and build reusable platform capabilities for performance testing, analysis, reporting, and trend visibility, solving complex technical problems and shipping large capabilities with minimal guidance.

- Turn lessons from early team engagements into reusable capabilities, documentation, and onboarding, measured by each new team needing less hands-on support than the last until teams can adopt the platform and manage their performance independently.

- Coordinate with peer teams across Developer Experience, Infrastructure Platforms, and product groups to align priorities and timing.

- Lead AI-first development practices in how we build and what we ship, including AI skills and agent-assisted performance workflows.

- Mentor engineers in performance engineering, platform design, and technical decision-making.

- Serve as a performance expert for other teams and provide technical guidance on initiatives spanning multiple groups.

- Take part in on-call or operational support where your team's ownership model requires it.

What you’ll bring

- Staff-level backend or platform engineering experience, including setting technical direction across a team and the teams around it.

- A track record of building and operating performance testing and analysis systems, with an understanding of where bottlenecks appear and how to find them.

- Experience leading or anchoring a performance enablement or platform function and achieving measurable adoption of internal tooling by influencing engineers and leaders who don't report to you.

- Experience defining and delivering a multi-quarter technical strategy or roadmap with engineering leadership.

- An AI-first development mindset demonstrated across the software lifecycle, including shaping how a team uses AI.

- Hands-on experience with load and performance testing tools such as k6 or equivalent, Kubernetes, and Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform, or similar cloud infrastructure.

- Clear written, asynchronous communication, including explaining performance trade-offs to engineers and leadership.

About the team

Performance Enablement is part of Platform Enablement within Developer Experience and Infrastructure Platforms. We work asynchronously and collaborate broadly across R&D, coordinating with peer platform and product groups. Documentation, onboarding, and feedback loops help us turn early team engagements into capabilities that scale beyond individual teams.

title: Software Development Engineer
description:
Location Details: 

At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full-time; others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.​

This is a remote position, so you’ll be working remotely from your home. You may occasionally visit a GoDaddy office to meet with your team for events or meetings. 

This position is not eligible to be performed in Alaska, Mississippi, North Dakota, or the Virgin Islands.

GoDaddy is not currently considering candidates for this role in California, Seattle, or NYC.

Join Our Team

Join our growth engineering team and help shape how customers discover, experience, and purchase GoDaddy’s AI-powered products.

Our team focuses on monetizing Airo, GoDaddy’s AI-powered website-building experience, through product-led growth. We build and optimize experiences that help free and trial users become paying customers while helping existing customers discover products and plans that provide greater value.

Our work spans pricing and plan experiences, upgrade flows, paywalls, trial-to-paid and free-to-paid journeys, contextual upsells, and post-purchase experiences. Experimentation is central to how we work. We regularly launch experiences as A/B tests, measure customer and business impact, and use those insights to determine what we iterate on and scale.

We’re a small, highly collaborative, remote-first team where engineers work closely with product management, design, analytics, and data science. We value ownership, thoughtful execution, quick learning, and continuously improving the customer experience.

What You’ll Get to Do…

As a Software Development Engineer III, you’ll build customer-facing experiences that directly influence how customers interact with and purchase GoDaddy products. You’ll have the opportunity to:

- Build and ship full-stack, customer-facing experiences using React and TypeScript, with opportunities to work with Node.js, APIs, and GraphQL across pricing, upgrades, checkout, and purchase journeys.

- Take product hypotheses from idea to production, using feature flags, cohorts, event tracking, testing, and experimentation to measure results and drive improvements.

- Partner closely with product managers and designers to define scope, influence the customer experience, and identify effective ways to test new ideas.

- Collaborate with data analysts and data scientists to understand experiment performance, conversion funnels, customer behavior, and opportunities for growth.

- Build and optimize contextual upgrade and monetization experiences that connect customers with the right products and plans at key moments in their journey.

- Write clean, maintainable, and testable code, contribute to code reviews, and improve shared components, tooling, and engineering practices.

Your Experience Should Include…

- 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent experience, with a track record of ownership, learning quickly, and delivering results.

- Strong professional experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and React, building production-ready, customer-facing applications.

- Experience shipping consumer-facing or SaaS product features end to end, from development and testing through production and iteration.

- Strong software engineering fundamentals, including testing, debugging, code reviews, Git, and CI/CD.

- Experience collaborating effectively with product, design, data, and engineering partners to deliver high-quality customer experiences.

- A strong product and business mindset, with the ability to connect engineering decisions to customer behavior, conversion, and business outcomes.

You Might Also Have…

- Experience with A/B testing and experimentation, including feature flags, cohorts, event tracking, analytics, conversion funnels, or growth and monetization products such as e-commerce, checkout, pricing, or SaaS subscriptions.

- Experience with modern front-end and full-stack technologies, including Redux, React Query, GraphQL, Node.js, and REST APIs, with exposure to reusable component libraries, accessibility, performance, internationalization, or building consumer-facing products at scale.

We encourage you to apply even if your experience or skillset doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement. We value a wide range of backgrounds and transferable skills, and we are excited to support learning and growth.

About us... GoDaddy is empowering everyday entrepreneurs around the world by providing the help and tools to succeed online, making opportunity more inclusive for all. GoDaddy is the place people come to name their idea, build a professional website, attract customers, sell their products and services, and manage their work. Our mission is to give our customers the tools, insights, and people to transform their ideas and personal initiative into success. To learn more about the company, visit About Us. 

At GoDaddy, we know diverse teams build better products—period. Our people and culture reflect and celebrate that sense of diversity and inclusion in ideas, experiences and perspectives. But we also know that’s not enough to build true equity and belonging in our communities. That’s why we prioritize integrating diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging principles into the core of how we work every day—focusing not only on our employee experience, but also our customer experience and operations. It’s the best way to serve our mission of empowering entrepreneurs everywhere, and making opportunity more inclusive for all. To read more about these commitments, as well as our representation and pay equity data, check out our Diversity and Pay Parity annual report which can be found on our Diversity Careers page.

We also embrace our diverse culture and offer a range of Employee Resource Groups (Culture). Have a side hustle? No problem. We love entrepreneurs! Most importantly, come as you are and make your own way. 

GoDaddy is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. GoDaddy will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with local and federal requirements. Refer to our full EEO policy.

Our recruiting team is available to assist you in completing your application. If they could be helpful, please reach out to myrecruiter@godaddy.com.

What We Offer: 

Working at GoDaddy offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, parental and wellness leave, healthcare, retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location. 

This role is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k)-retirement plan, paid sick time, paid flexible time off, paid parental leave, life insurance, short- and long-term disability, AD&D insurance, mental health or EAP programs, remote or hybrid work options, paid holidays, paid Wellness days, tuition assistance, adoption, surrogacy, and fertility benefits, dependent daycare and backup care benefits, Employee stock purchase plan, financial education and advice; and other benefits in accordance with GoDaddy’s benefit plans and applicable law.

title: Senior Web Developer -MFE/AEM
description:

- Deliver reliable, accessible features across the AEM and React/Next.js boundary, from discovery through production support.

- Make sound, clearly explained design decisions and identify risks, dependencies, and trade-offs early.

- Partner with QA on functional, integration, regression, accessibility, and performance testing.

- Support CI/CD, environment readiness, deployments, release coordination, and production issue triage with DevOps and platform teams.

- Investigate defects and incidents, determine root causes, implement durable fixes, and contribute to operational readiness.

Stakeholder & Cross-Team Collaboration
- Work effectively with product owners, business stakeholders, architects, designers, QA, DevOps, and other engineering teams.

- Coordinate integration points and ownership across teams; raise dependencies and risks early and follow actions through to resolution.

- Explain technical concepts and decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

- 8+ years of professional software development experience building, enhancing, and supporting production web applications, with senior-level engineering judgment and ownership.

- Strong hands-on proficiency with React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

- Demonstrated experience designing, building, and maintaining micro-frontends and integrating them into a larger application or digital platform.

- · Hands-on Adobe Experience Manager experience, including integrating front-end applications or micro-frontends with AEM.

- Experience with AEM Sites or AEM as a Cloud Service, HTL/Sightly, editable templates, Sling Models, OSGi services, workflows, and authoring concepts.

- Solid understanding of modern web architecture, component-based development, API integration, rendering approaches, and content-managed experiences.

- Experience with server-side rendering, static generation, hydration, or other Next.js rendering patterns.

- Ability to assess technical approaches and contribute to architecture and design decisions, balancing maintainability, scalability, accessibility, performance, and delivery needs.

- Experience with code reviews, automated testing, version control, and collaborative software delivery practices.

- Strong communication, collaboration, problem-solving, and prioritization skills; demonstrated ability to coach or guide developers.

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with cloud platforms, CI/CD pipelines, deployment practices, observability, CDN/caching, or production support.

- Mentorship: Mentor junior engineers, foster a collaborative team culture, and promote engineering excellence.

- Programming Expertise: Extensive experience in at least one general-purpose programming language (e.g., Java, C, C++). Exceptional coding skills with the ability to fluently translate design into maintainable, scalable, and unit-tested code.

- Concurrency: Strong hands-on experience with multi-threading and concurrent programming.

- System Design: Deep expertise in Object-Oriented Design (OOD), design patterns, and building intuitive module and class-level interfaces.

Role Summary:
Experian Partner Solutions is looking for Senior Web Engineers to build the products our partners white label as their own – embedded components that run inside partner applications, and hosted sites that carry a partner's brand. When a partner puts our software in front of their customers, our code runs under their brand, in their environment, with their reputation attached. There is no margin for "it works on my machine."
Predominantly JavaScript and TypeScript across the browser and the server – React on the front end, Node in our services and tooling.
We are building this team around AI-assisted development. That is not a perk in the job description – it is the operating model. You will spend a significant share of your time directing AI coding agents, reviewing what those agents produce, and being personally accountable for code you did not type character by character.
 
What You'll Be Doing:
- Oversee web software end-to-end – develop, and support it in production. Overseeership does not stop at the merge.
- Direct AI coding agents as your primary implementation method rather than hand-writing every line.
- Make the architecture calls AI cannot make for you: interface and API design, state and service boundaries, versioning, and backward compatibility for consumers who depend on your releases.
- Design for environments you do not control, whether that is a hostile host page, an unfamiliar partner configuration, or an unexpected client of your API.
- Use AI to create test suites and regression coverage, then look for what the generator missed: adversarial inputs, integration conflicts, and configuration edge cases.
Agentic Responsibilities:
- Use AI coding assistants – Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, Kiro, or equivalent – as a primary development tool.
- Decompose a non-trivial feature into chunks an agent completes reliably.
- Explain what makes a prompt produce usable code rather than plausible-looking garbage.
- Use AI to create tests, paired with a clear view of where those tests give false confidence.

What We're Looking For:
- 6+ years building and shipping production web software, with ownership of what you built after it went live.
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience.
- JavaScript and TypeScript, applied across the browser and the server. We work in React and Node; expertise in a comparable ecosystem plus evidence you pick up new stacks quickly is equally welcome.
- Component libraries, design systems, or SDKs consumed by teams outside your own — where breaking changes carry cost.
- You will directly report to Director

description:
The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. 

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. 

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

PayPal

0

title: Software Development Engineer II
description:
Why this role exists

JustCall is building AI voice agents that do more than just have conversations. They answer calls, qualify leads, schedule appointments, update CRMs and trigger business workflows autonomously.

But for these AI agents to be truly useful, they need to work seamlessly with the tools businesses already rely on. A conversation should be able to trigger an action, update a deal, create a task or initiate the next step in a workflow without human intervention.

That's where you come in.

We're looking for a Backend Engineer who enjoys building integrations, connecting systems and making AI powered workflows work reliably in the real world. You'll work at the intersection of our AI infrastructure and the business applications our customers use every day, helping bring JustCall's AI capabilities into their existing workflows.

You'll build integrations where they don't exist, extend existing connectors for AI specific use cases, and develop the backend services that allow our voice agents to take meaningful actions.

What You'll Actually Do

- Build AI powered integrations: Connect JustCall's AI voice agent platform (AIVA) with the business tools our customers use, including CRM's, project management platforms, communication tools and custom webhook endpoints.
- Develop integrations from scratch: Build integrations when native connectors aren't available, working with REST APIs, OAuth flows, webhook handlers and event transformations.
- Extend existing connectors: Collaborate with the integrations team to customise existing connectors and support AI specific workflows that traditional integrations weren't designed for.
- Build backend services: Develop Node.js services and APIs that power agent actions, workflow execution, integration payloads and state management, using MongoDB for data storage.
- Contribute to AI infrastructure: Work on shared backend systems supporting asynchronous job processing, event pipelines, retries and fallback mechanisms to ensure workflows execute reliably.
- Design reliable API contracts: Document integration specifications, workflow behaviour, API schemas and integration contracts so other engineering teams can build on top of them.
- Own features end to end: Take ownership of development, testing, debugging and deployment while collaborating with the AI and integrations teams to deliver reliable solutions.

What We're Looking For

- Strong backend fundamentals: 3+ years of hands on experience with Node.js and JavaScript or TypeScript, with the ability to independently design, build and ship backend services.
- Database fundamentals: Working knowledge of MongoDB, including schema design, querying, data modelling and managing state across workflows.
- API and integration experience: Comfortable working with REST APIs, webhooks and third party integrations. You should be able to read API documentation, understand authentication flows and translate requirements into working integrations independently.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (TypeScript + AI) - Remote - India
description:
About FullStack

FullStack is your AI-native engineering partner, built to turn AI capability into certainty. Most companies can demo AI; few can get it to production and prove what it produced. We close that gap with three capabilities, AI built into your products from the start, elite vetted talent who apply it, and transparent execution that shows value every step of the way. With now over 600 customers in North America, FullStack is one integrated partner for all your AI engineering needs. With FullStack, you move forward with confidence.

We’re Most Proud Of

- Offering life-changing career opportunities to talented software professionals across the Americas.
- Building highly-skilled software development teams for hundreds of the world’s greatest companies.
- Having delivered hundreds of successful custom software solutions, which have positively impacted the lives and careers of millions of users.
- Our 4.1-star rating on GlassDoor.
- Our client Net Promoter Score of 68, twice the industry average.

The Position

Forward Deployed Engineers sit inside the client’s problem, not next to it. You embed with an enterprise team, find the work that actually warrants AI, architect the system, build it, and make it hold up in the real environment.

This is a three-way role: consultant, operator, engineer. You should be as comfortable pressure-testing a business case with a COO or VP of Engineering as you are debugging why an agent’s tool-calling loop degraded after a context change. The people who succeed here can hold a discovery conversation on Monday and ship what they scoped on Thursday.

On this track, your edge is application engineering: you make agents real inside the client’s actual systems, workflows, and delivery pipelines.

We work with regulated industries and Fortune 500 clients who have AI mandates, real constraints, and low tolerance for demos that don’t hold up.

How We Approach The Work

FDEs are trusted to shape the solution, not only deliver it. Every engagement calls for architect-level judgment:

- Reframes the request. Treats “we need an agent for X” as a hypothesis, not a spec.
- Decomposes the problem. Outcome → process → decisions → data → systems → actors → constraints — before choosing technology.
- Chooses the intervention. Remove, simplify, traditional software, automation, LLM, RAG, agent, or multi-agent — and defends why.
- Owns the architecture decision. Documents trade-offs (ADRs), sets success metrics, pushes back on scope that won’t deliver value.

Consultative Discovery

Clients rarely arrive with a fully formed problem, and the FDE’s first contribution is helping them see it clearly. You lead discovery with genuine curiosity, moving the conversation from stated requirements to underlying needs, and you build credibility through the depth of your understanding rather than the breadth of your pitch.

- Uncovers business drivers. What outcome matters, what it’s worth, why now, and what happens if nothing changes.
- Uncovers personal drivers. What each stakeholder is measured on, what they’re worried about, and what a win looks like for them individually.
- Surfaces constraints early. Security, compliance, data access, budget, skills, politics, timelines — the things that kill projects in month two.
- Aligns stakeholders. Spots conflicting goals between business, engineering, and risk, and brings them to a shared definition of success.
- Asks strategic questions. Follows the answer with “why,” “how do you know,” and “what happens today when…” — without interrogating. Clients leave the conversation understanding their own problem better.
- Earns authority through depth. Credibility comes from the quality of the questions and the insight in the playback, not from pitching technology.

What You'll Do

- Discover. Run workshops and process discovery with business and engineering stakeholders. Separate genuine AI problems from workflow problems wearing an AI costume. Come back with a scoped, defensible point of view.
- Structure the process and the spec. For any business or engineering process being automated, map the current state, decision points, and exceptions, then turn it into specifications that both people and AI systems can execute against reliably.
- Architect & design. Design agentic systems end to end — orchestration, context and retrieval architecture, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and the boundaries between deterministic and non-deterministic components.
- Build. Ship working systems — agents, multi-step automations, internal tooling, integration layers. You are hands-on. Prototypes that prove value in weeks, not slideware.
- Engineer the delivery system. Own CI/CD for what you build: build, test, release, environments.
- Consult. Present to and defend decisions in front of CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and business leadership. Quantify impact in their terms. Support pre-sales scoping and proposal work when the deal calls for it.

What We're Looking For

- 5+ years of professional software development experience with at least one mainstream production stack (TypeScript/Node.js, Python, Java, C#/.NET, or Go).
- 1 - 4 years of professional experience building and shipping LLM-powered and agentic AI systems beyond prototypes or demos.
- Advanced English is required.
- Successful completion of a four-year college degree is required.
- Hands-on experience with frontier AI developer tools including Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, or OpenAI Codex.
- Proven experience evaluating current-state environments and defining technical roadmaps.
- Demonstrated experience with APIs, service design, event-driven and distributed systems, and data modeling.
- Experience designing and owning CI/CD pipelines, including build, test, release, environments, and deployment processes.
- Strong understanding of context and specification engineering to produce reliable AI output.
- Solid understanding of enterprise integration patterns, including APIs, webhooks, event streams, iPaaS platforms such as n8n or MuleSoft, and MCP.
- Track record of leading client-facing discovery calls, asking "why" before "how" to decompose unstructured business problems.
- Skilled at exercising end-to-end delivery ownership and managing project scope without requiring product manager supervision.
- Ability to work through new and difficult issues and contribute to libraries as needed.
- Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications.
- Forensic attention to detail.
- A positive mindset and a can-do attitude.
- Experience working on Agile / Scrum teams.
- Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems.
- Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon.
- Ability to identify with the goals of FullStack's clients, and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them.

Strong Plus

- Production AI operations (Day 2): eval harnesses, observability and tracing, cost and token economics, drift, debugging non-deterministic systems.
- Prompt- and eval-level regression testing running in CI and gating releases.
- Delivery in regulated environments (financial services, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing).
- Pre-sales support: discovery calls, SOW and estimate shaping, technical proposal defense.
- Process mining, operations analysis, or transformation consulting background.
- Client enablement and training — building the client team’s capability, not just the system.
- Prior consulting or agency environment; comfort with ambiguity and multiple accounts.

Work Authorization Requirements

- Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the country of this job posting on a full-time basis.
- FullStack will not sponsor applicants for work visas now or in the future.

What We Offer

- Competitive pay.
- 100% remote work.
- The ability to work with leading startups and Fortune 500 companies.
- Continuing education opportunities.
- Opportunity to grow and expand your career.

Our focus is on connecting talent with projects based on qualifications, ensuring a fair and transparent process that values diverse perspectives and global collaboration.

title: Staff Software Engineer

You will partner closely with Product, Design, Clinical, Quality, and other engineering teams to take problems from discovery through production. This is an opportunity to work on high-impact, workflow-heavy products where thoughtful technical decisions can improve care-team efficiency, member experience, and Hinge Health’s ability to deliver care at scale.

This is a hands-on Staff Engineer role. You will write production code, lead architecture and design reviews, participate in operational response, and coach engineers toward stronger technical ownership.

What You'll Accomplish

- Deliver large projects that introduce new product capabilities, often acting as a maintainer for key code repositories. 
- Break down complex problems into manageable tasks, ensuring steady and predictable delivery while identifying and resolving root causes of incidents. 
- Collaborate with your team to roadmap and execute ambitious technical strategies, balancing short-term and long-term trade-offs. 
- Mentor and support junior engineers, providing thoughtful code reviews and real-time pairing. 
- Integrate and leverage AI technologies to automate processes and enhance product features, contributing to Hinge Health’s AI-driven care platform. 
- Proactively improve the maintainability, availability, and performance of the team’s features, and contribute to the team’s overall architecture and developer tooling. 
- Communicate technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical partners, and document solutions for future reference. 

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days/week.

This is a Bengaluru-based role that involves regular interaction and collaboration with Hinge Health colleagues in San Francisco, CA.

- Time zones: San Francisco is in the Pacific Time Zone, which is 12 hours and 30 minutes behind India Standard Time (e.g., 8am in San Francisco is 8:30pm in Bengaluru). 
- Hours: Applicants should be open to meetings in the late evening following India Standard Time to align with San Francisco working hours (8am - 6pm PT). 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering or related technical field
- 10+ years of non-internship full time professional software development experience
- 4+ years of experience with at least one software programming language
- 4+ years of experience in the full software development life cycle
- 3+ years of work experience with react JS and Node JS/ Typescript
- 1+ years of experience in mentoring and leading junior team members, collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams, and contributing to project planning and decision-making
- Experience with using AI tools such as Github copilot, Cursor, LangChain, LangGraph
- Experience delivering large software projects or features in a production environment. 
- Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, Java, JavaScript, etc.). 

Preferred Qualifications

- A platform-as-product mindset: understanding internal users and consumers, defining clear contracts, improving developer experience and adoption, and measuring platform outcomes. 
- Strong backend and distributed-systems fundamentals, including latency, throughput, availability, capacity, backpressure, consistency, resilience, and failure-mode analysis. 
- Experience integrating large language models or generative AI services into production workflows with appropriate evals, validation, observability, and failure handling. 
- Experience defining and maintaining SLOs and SLAs, using error budgets, service-health metrics, alerting, on-call practices, incident response, and root-cause analysis to improve reliability. 
- Experience improving observability through metrics, structured logs, traces, dashboards, and actionable alerts, with practical knowledge of cache design and invalidation, database performance KPIs, query and index tuning, connection pools, and capacity management
- Experience with headless CMS integrations, webhook-driven systems, vendor adapters, content delivery networks, or publishing pipelines. 
- Experience with durable workflow orchestration systems such as Temporal, or comparable workflow technology. 
- Experience with media processing tools such as ffmpeg, adaptive bitrate video, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, or caption formats such as WebVTT. 
- Experience with event streaming, such as Kafka, and CI/CD automation, such as GitHub Actions. 
- Experience working in healthcare, privacy-sensitive, regulated, or otherwise high-trust environments. 
- Experience mentoring senior engineers or serving as a technical lead for a platform, migration, or cross-functional launch. 

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com.

What You'll Love About Us

- Inclusive healthcare and benefits: In addition to comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we provide employees and their family members with Group Medical Coverage (GMC), Group Term Life Insurance (GTL), and Group Personal Accident Insurance (GPA). 
- Well-being & Growth: We offer a lifestyle stipend to support your overall well-being, along with learning and development opportunities to help you grow both personally and professionally. 
- Ownership: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions. 

Culture & Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the Personnel and Candidate Privacy Policy.

Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth.com.

Job Description

About the Role

As Jefferies transitions from traditional SaaS workflows to an Agentic AI Operating Model, the skillsets required to manage the platform shift fundamentally. The platform relies on continuous monitoring, external signal processing (Watcher Agents), and Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) governance.

We are seeking a hybrid engineering profile—a Lead AI Engineer—who bridges the gap between enterprise systems integration, LLM prompt governance, and complex business logic. This role goes beyond traditional "keep the lights on" IT support; this individual will act as the operational pilot of the AI platform, tuning agent behavior, ensuring data security, and evolving the system's capabilities to meet dynamic business demands.

You will be the primary technical owner of the platform: operating and hardening it in production, extending its AI agent workflows and enterprise integrations, and driving the Phase 2 roadmap (candidate portal, scheduling, assessments, and further automation).

Technology Stack

- Frontend: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, React Router
- Backend: Python 3.12+, FastAPI, Pydantic, async I/O, Server-Sent Events (SSE)

- Database: MongoDB / Amazon DocumentDB (document modeling, async access via Motor)
- Cloud & DevOps: AWS, Docker, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, structured logging, metrics, tracing, audit trails
- Enterprise integrations: Oracle ORC (HRIS — requisitions, candidates, scorecards), PeopleSoft incl. CSS (staffing & comp), background-check vendor APIs (e.g., First Advantage — bidirectional), DocuSign e-signature, Microsoft Exchange / Outlook via Graph API, ServiceNow ITSM
- Sourcing channel integrations: LinkedIn Recruiter System Connect (One-Click Export ingest), Indeed Retrieve Candidates API (GraphQL + OAuth), Naukri ATS webhook ingest

Key Responsibilities

- Own production operations of the platform: monitoring, incident response, root-cause analysis, patching, upgrades, and SLA adherence (“keep the lights on”).
- Evolve the platform on the delivered foundation: design, build, and ship new features across the React frontend and FastAPI backend.
- Maintain and extend agentic AI workflows — agent nodes, prompts, guardrails, tool bindings, and human-in-the-loop approval gates — including evaluation and bias-governance of AI scoring.
- Operate and extend the connector framework integrating Oracle ORC, PeopleSoft, BGC vendors, DocuSign, Exchange/O365, and ServiceNow.
- Maintain sourcing-channel ingestion pipelines — LinkedIn RSC candidate export, Indeed Retrieve Candidates API streaming, and Naukri webhook receivers — feeding the Sourcing Agent's scoring and shortlisting.
- Manage data models and pipelines in MongoDB/DocumentDB, ensuring data quality, sync integrity across systems of record, and auditability.
- Own the AWS infrastructure via IaC and CI/CD; manage environments, releases, security posture (SSO/RBAC), and cost.

- Partner with HR Ops, Recruiting, Legal/Compliance, and IT stakeholders to prioritize the backlog and translate business needs into platform capabilities.
- Agent Operations: Monitor, tune, and deploy updates to specialized AI process agents (e.g., automated sourcing, offer generation, candidate triage) utilizing Jefferies' internal LLM gateways.
- Ontology & Knowledge Base Maintenance: Continuously update the system’s Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) knowledge graph (e.g., uploading new compliance policies, visa regulations, or compensation matrices) to ensure agents reason against the latest ground-truth data.
- Data Sovereignty & PII Handling: Proven ability to architect data-masking pipelines to ensure highly sensitive data (Compensation, SSNs, Diversity metrics) is encrypted, scrubbed, and strictly isolated from broader LLM reasoning engines.
- Algorithmic Bias & Regulatory Auditing: Familiarity with validating AI outputs against strict employment and compliance laws (e.g., EEOC guidelines, NY Fair Chance Act constraints) to ensure automated workflows remain legally defensible and auditable.
- Lead knowledge transfer from the delivery partner and serve as the internal technical authority for the platform.

title: Senior Software Engineer – Core Team
description:
About TrueFoundry

Every production AI system, whether it's powering customer support, writing code, analyzing financial data, or diagnosing medical conditions, needs the same foundational infrastructure.A way to route between models. A way to manage tools and integrate them securely. A way to orchestrate agents and enforce governance. A unified compute layer to run it all.

That infrastructure layer is being built right now.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer-Core Team.

The Problem We're Solving

Companies are moving beyond simple chatbots to production agentic systems. These systems route between OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and self-hosted models. They integrate dozens of tools via protocols like MCP. They orchestrate multi-agent workflows where agents coordinate with other agents.

The infrastructure to support this doesn't exist yet. You can't just duct-tape together a few API calls and call it production-ready.

You Need a Control Plane That Handles

- Intelligent routing with observability, cost policies, and fallback logic
- Centralized tool and MCP server management with security and lifecycle controls
- Agent orchestration with governance and guardrails
- A unified compute layer to run self-hosted models, custom tools, and agents

AI Gateway is the control plane: five composable components (Prompts, LLM Gateway, MCP Gateway, Guardrails, Agent Gateway) that handle routing, orchestration, and governance.

We're Series A, backed by Intel Capital and Sequoia. Companies like CVS, Mastercard, Siemens, Paytm, Synopsys, and Zscaler run production AI workloads on our platform.

Who You Are

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Staff Software Engineer
Bengaluru · Hybrid · Reports to Engineering Manager

Nexla, briefly
Nexla is the data layer for enterprise AI. We give AI apps and agents the connectivity, context, and governance to work across more than 1,000 enterprise systems in real time, and we process over a trillion records a month doing it. DoorDash, LinkedIn, Johnson & Johnson, Instacart, and LiveRamp run mission-critical data on us. Honorable Mention in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Data Integration Tools, and top-rated by customers on Gartner Peer Insights four years running. Founded 2016, remote-first, headquartered in San Mateo.
Our values are short and we actually use them: Have Empathy. Be Curious. Be Intellectually Honest. Achieve Excellence. Remember to Relax.

Role
You would work on the backend systems that move data through Nexla: JVM services, the streaming runtime on Kafka, and the distributed processing underneath. Production Java every day. Nobody hands you a finished design. You own systems end to end, from design through deploy to on-call, and you debug them when they break. The role sits between our platform and integration layers, so you would work across both rather than inside one. Small, focused team, which is why the ownership is real rather than nominal.

What you’ll own
- Core framework features, designed and shipped by you. Schema evolution, pagination, rate limiting, circuit breaking, and the automated retries and self-recovery that keep pipelines running without a human watching. The SDKs and interfaces other teams build on sit here too: you write them, document them, and use them yourself.
- The streaming and processing path in production. Kafka, Spark, and Flink workloads, checkpointing, backpressure, and failure recovery. You operate what you build.
- Technical direction. Architecture for multi-tenancy, high concurrency, and low latency, plus the technology calls underneath it: where the JVM is the right answer, where an alternative runtime is better, and how to cut infrastructure cost without giving up reliability.
- The hard debugging. Trace failures across Kafka clusters, distributed runtimes, and flaky third-party APIs, fix them, then build the guardrails so they do not come back.
Staff scope: you work directly with Product and the CTO to turn customer needs and market shifts, from GenAI data ingestion to real-time CDC and agentic workflows, into technical plans. On a team this size your standards become the team’s standards.
Roughly 60% building and shipping, 25% architecture and technical direction, 15% code review, design sessions, and the RFCs, runbooks, and docs that come with them.

The hard problem
Our platform integrates with more than a thousand external systems, each with its own schema quirks, auth scheme, rate limits, and retry semantics. The framework problem is the N+1 one: making the thousandth integration as cheap to add as the tenth. That means absorbing the differences into the abstraction rather than special-casing them, while the data underneath keeps moving at production volume.

Must-haves
- 10 to 14 years of software engineering, with significant time building platforms, frameworks, or SDKs rather than end-user applications.
- Expert-level Java. You understand JVM memory management, concurrency models, and non-blocking I/O well enough to diagnose a thread starvation issue from a heap dump.
- Deep experience with distributed systems in production: Kafka, Spark, Flink, or similar. You have operated these systems, not just used them.
- Comfort with the modern data stack and the protocols around it: Snowflake, Databricks, gRPC, GraphQL, webhooks, and CDC.
- You have owned production systems and know what good operational discipline looks like.
- You use AI tools in your actual work and can say specifically where they help and where they mislead you.

Bonus points
- Contributions to open-source data projects such as Airbyte, Flink, Debezium, or Arrow.
- Time at an iPaaS or ELT company: MuleSoft, Fivetran, Informatica, Airbyte, or similar.
- Deep Kubernetes and cloud-native experience, including Strimzi for Kafka.
- Security architecture: OAuth 2.0, mTLS, and encrypted credential management at scale.

You’ll thrive here if
- You want ownership and will take it. You write code every day and you carry what you ship, through deploy and on-call.
- You are comfortable defining scope on the fly and shipping before the full picture is clear.
- You would rather build the guardrail than fix the same failure twice.
- You are fine with your standards becoming the team’s standards. On a team this size, they will.
One thing to be clear about: our product definition is still moving as AI reshapes data integration, and the platform has to move with it. If you want a stable, well-defined surface to work on, this is not it.

How we hire
Four conversations, about two weeks end to end.
- Coding. Working through real code rather than a puzzle. 60 mins.
- Low-level design. How you structure a system at the class and interface level, and the tradeoffs you would defend. 60 mins.
- High-level design. Distributed systems design on a problem close to what we run in production. 60 mins.
- Product deep dive and fit. Our product in depth, and whether the scope of this role is what you actually want. 60 mins.
On AI in the coding round. Use it the way you would on the job, ours or anyone else’s. You are someone who can zoom out to shape architecture decisions and zoom in to deliver production-ready code, all while keeping business goals in focus. You thrive in ambiguity, take end-to-end ownership, and set the engineering bar for those around you. You also bring a forward-thinking mindset — actively embracing AI coding assistants and agentic workflows as tools that make you and your team measurably more effective. You will partner closely with product, design, and cross-functional engineering teams to lead the design, development, and delivery of high-performance, full-stack platform capabilities.

In This Role, You Will:

- Mentor and technically guide engineers on the team, elevating code quality, design thinking, and engineering culture through hands-on involvement and thoughtful feedback.
- Own the full delivery lifecycle — from design and development through deployment, monitoring, and production support — with minimal oversight and maximum accountability.
- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and containerized services, ensuring reliable, predictable releases and a healthy engineering delivery cadence.
- Act as a bridge between technical complexity and business priorities — translating ambiguous requirements into clear, actionable engineering plans and communicating progress and trade-offs effectively to stakeholders.

Here's What You Need:

- Strong experience with React for building modern, responsive frontend applications — including component-based architecture, state management, API integration, and performance optimization.

Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end-to-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen & Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass & Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North & South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.

Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specializing in technology.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Software Engineer to build agentic front ends and supporting engineering systems for our products. Most of our products currently offer UI based interaction to our customers. Given the complexity involved in the flows, traditional UI based interaction needs training for users before they can develop desired proficiency in the product.
We want to build NLP based interactive UIs where AI agents make flows not only easier to learn but also provide suggestive inputs to aid design process. This role will attempt at revolutionizing UI/UX for our customers by offering them a guided flow and thereby eliminating learning curve needed for understanding complex design process.

Key Responsibilities

- Design and implement agentic workflows in the frontend (multi-step AI-driven user journeys)

- Handle state management to ensure proper context is available LLMs to provide decision support
- Translate complex backend agent logic to clear, user-friendly interfaces
- Implement real-time interactions (chat interfaces, copilots (AI based kitchen designing), suggestions, searches etc.)
- Ensure performance, scalability, and responsiveness of AI-powered UI flows
- Contribute to design systems that support AI-native UX patterns
- Write clean, maintainable, production-ready code with strong software design principles, automated testing, and code reviews

- Define standards and guidelines for appropriate software tools and frameworks used for building agentic flows

- Strong software engineering fundamentals (Data Structures, Algorithms, Object-Oriented/Functional Programming, System Design)
- Understanding of modern state management patterns, frontend architecture, and browser performance optimization
- Familiarity with Git, unit testing frameworks, containerization (Docker), and basic CI/CD pipeline integration

Soft Skills

- Experience working in teams building complex web products
- Ability to work in ambiguous, fast-evolving tech spaces
- Clear communication with cross-functional teams

Working for Us

At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. description:
Introduction

About The Team

The Connect UI team builds the experiences Confluent Cloud customers use to bring data into and out of Kafka. That covers browsing and setting up fully managed and custom connectors, troubleshooting connector failures with AI assistance, and visualizing how connectors are performing. Connectors are where customers' real-time data enters the platform, so the quality of what we build directly affects how quickly customers get up and running

About The Role

We are looking for a Frontend Software Engineer who's excited to help build engaging, intuitive products for managing and visualizing large-scale, real-time data streams. Data flow is central to how companies operate, and we aim to make that experience simple and attractive. Working with mentorship from senior engineers, you will help develop features across the Connect experience in Confluent Cloud and steadily grow into an owner of parts of the product.

- Our Cloud UI is built with React and TypeScript on our own design system, and connects to multiple REST and GraphQL APIs.
- We test with Jest and React Testing Library (unit) and Playwright (end-to-end).
- We deploy to production daily and can test every commit, including PRs, before it goes live. Feature flags let us release independently of backend teams, and bots keep our dependencies up to date.
- AI-assisted development tools are part of our everyday engineering workflow.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Frontend Software Engineer, you will help build client-side features for data-intensive products, working closely with senior engineers, designers and product managers.

You Will

- Help develop new features from user requirements and designs, taking on well-defined tasks within larger features, delivering them on time, refining them based on feedback, and growing the scope you own over time.
- Build UI components and interactions to the design specifications using our design system, and integrate with backend APIs, working with backend engineers to understand API contracts and handle loading, error and empty states well.
- Write clean, readable code with unit and end-to-end tests, and write short design notes for your tasks for peer review.
- Take part in code reviews, both receiving and giving feedback.
- Help investigate and fix bugs and production issues, starting by shadowing the on-call rotation.
- Share your progress clearly in standups and project updates, and raise blockers early.
- Learn Confluent's engineering practices, including release, monitoring and feature flag processes, and how our product works end to end.

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

- Experience with 0.6 –1 year of professional experience and a strong foundation in data structures, algorithms and problem-solving
- Strong JavaScript fundamentals, including asynchronous programming (promises, async/await), closures and the DOM, plus solid HTML and CSS skills, including responsive layouts
- A good understanding of React (components, props, state, hooks, and how components re-render) and a basic understanding of frontend architecture: structuring components, managing state, and separating data fetching from UI
- Experience building and bundling a frontend project with Webpack or a similar tool such as Vite, including an understanding of modules, loaders and code splitting
- Comfort debugging with browser developer tools, and familiarity with Git and a pull-request-based workflow
- Curiosity, eagerness to learn and openness to feedback, with good communication and collaboration skills and a team-first mindset

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

- Awareness of web accessibility and web performance (for example, bundle size and Core Web Vitals)
- Experience with data visualization or charting libraries
- Exposure to AI-powered workflows, agentic AI or LLM-based applications
- Internships, open-source contributions, hackathons or personal projects you've built and shipped
- Interest in data streaming, Kafka or distributed systems (no prior experience needed)

- Drive Technical Excellence: Improve code structure and architecture across your team’s remit, performing high-impact code reviews to ensure quality and scalability. 
- Lead Project Planning: Foresee dependencies and risks, partnering closely with Product and Design to ensure smooth delivery of complex features.

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

- Strong Engineering Principles: Deep pride in writing readable, well-designed, and well-tested software. 
- Backend Expertise: Significant experience building web-based applications (we use Go, Ruby/Rails, Python, Scala, and Rust).

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. - Proficiency in building scalable backend services. Experience with Python, Django, Golang, MongoDB, and AWS is highly preferred.

title: Software Development Engineer - 2
description:
Job Title: Software Development Engineer - 2
Location: Bangalore (On-site; full-time)
About Locus
Battle-tested in 350+ deployments across 30+ countries, Locus is an agentic Transportation Management System for all-mile, all-channel, trusted by enterprises like Unilever, Nestlé, and Siam Makro.
The platform unifies orders, capacity, and carrier networks into one living plan, aligning planning, execution, and settlement so promises become proof. AI co-pilots with guardrails surface risk early and recommend the next best move to protect SLAs and reduce empty miles.
In 2025, Locus joined the Ingka Group (IKEA Retail) family, marking a major milestone in our journey. Backed by the scale and strength of IKEA, we continue to operate independently while accelerating our mission to make global supply chains faster, smarter, and more sustainable.
Our Journey and Impact
Since 2015, Locus has been on a mission to make logistics decision-making intelligent, sustainable, and real-world ready. Our platform has powered billions of deliveries across 30 + countries for global enterprises, driving measurable impact in cost savings, carbon reduction, and SLA performance. With the strength of the IKEA ecosystem behind us, we’re scaling that impact even further.
Our Global Footprint
Headquartered in Bangalore, with teams across the U.S., U.K., UAE, and Southeast Asia, Locus brings together 170 + engineers, designers, and problem-solvers united by a single goal: to reinvent how the world moves goods.
Traits We Value
We look for people who are:
- Global in mindset: curious about diverse markets and ideas.
- Unrelenting in drive: energized by complex challenges.
- Intelligent in approach: analytical, creative, and thoughtful.
- Dynamic in execution: adaptive and decisive in fast-moving contexts.
- Exact in craft: detail-oriented and committed to excellence.

About the Role:
As an Software Development Engineer -2, Backend Engineer at Locus, you will play a pivotal role in building robust, scalable, and high-performance backend systems. You will be at the forefront of designing solutions that can handle millions of transactions, ensuring reliability, security, and innovation across our products.

- System Design: Architect scalable backend services and APIs, focusing on low-latency and high-throughput systems.
- Core Development: Build, test, and deploy features using Python, ensuring code quality and maintainability.
- Performance Optimization: Analyze and optimize application performance and scalability by addressing bottlenecks and implementing efficient algorithms.
- Database Management: Design, query, and maintain complex databases (relational and NoSQL), ensuring data consistency and availability.
- Integration: Collaborate with frontend and data teams to integrate backend services seamlessly.
- Ownership: Take end-to-end responsibility for assigned modules or features, from requirements gathering to production deployment and monitoring.
- Security: Implement robust security practices to safeguard systems and user data.
- Code Reviews: Conduct thorough peer reviews to maintain coding standards and share knowledge within the team.
- Mentorship: Guide junior engineers, fostering a culture of learning and innovation.
- Software Factory & AI Tooling: Build, integrate, and leverage internal software factory harnesses using tools like Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode to streamline workflows and boost engineering productivity.
- Agentic AI & Copilots: Architect and implement productized AI copilots and multi-agent systems within the Locus TMS platform, designing complex workflows, tool-calling mechanisms, and robust evals framework.

Join Locus and become part of a visionary team that is redefining logistics through innovation and smart distribution. We provide competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a collaborative environment where your expertise will drive both your growth and that of the organization.

description:
About Us

If you want to build, develop, and see your impact, join Skillz and level up your Career!

Skillz, the first publicly-traded mobile eSports platform that hosts billions of casual mobile gaming tournaments for millions of players worldwide, is revolutionizing the gaming industry. By fostering social competition within games, the Skillz platform helps developers build multi-million dollar franchises by enabling real-money activity in their games and providing operational support while connecting players through fair, enjoyable, and meaningful competition.

At Skillz, we understand the thrill of achievement and the satisfaction of overcoming challenges. Want to join a team made up of alums from Apple, Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Tesla, Twitter (X), Roblox, Zynga, Samsung, Lyft, EA, Riot, Nexon, Gameskraft, PlayStation, Unity, Scopely, Tinder, Intel, Deloitte, EY, Twitch, DraftKings, Wynn Resorts and more? Learn more to see if Skillz is the right fit for your next career move!

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll design, build, and operate the distributed backend services that power real-time gaming experiences. You’ll work across the full development lifecycle in an agile environment, from technical design through deployment and production operations. You’ll raise the bar for engineering quality, operational excellence, and customer impact.

This role suits someone who enjoys hard technical problems in low-latency, high-throughput systems, communicates clearly with engineers and leadership alike, and takes ownership of outcomes, not just tasks.

What You’ll Do

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable, high-performance backend services in Golang and/or Java.
- Build and evolve distributed, multi-tiered systems using caching layers (Redis, Memcached) and relational databases.
- Develop low-latency, real-time applications that support live competitive gameplay.
- Set the standard for operational excellence and drive measurable improvements in customer SLAs and system KPIs.
- Balance paying down technical debt with shipping customer value.
- Explain technical challenges, trade-offs, and solutions through design documents, reviews, and presentations to audiences ranging from engineers to senior leadership and cross-functional partners.
- Deploy and run services on public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and container orchestration platforms like Kubernetes.
- Mentor teammates and build a culture of ownership, quality, and accountability within the team.
- Work with product, design, and other cross-functional teams to turn business needs into solid technical solutions.

What We’re Looking For

- 5+ years of professional software development experience in Golang and/or Java.
- Strong experience with distributed, multi-tiered systems, caching (e.g., Redis, Memcached), and relational databases.
- Experience building low-latency, high-performance applications in real-time systems.
- Proficiency with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
- Hands-on experience with Kubernetes or similar container technologies.
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent industry experience.

Core Competencies

- Solid computer science fundamentals: object-oriented design, algorithm design, data structures, problem solving, and complexity analysis.
- Strong knowledge of public cloud services and modern service architectures.
- Excellent communication skills across formats (technical design docs, code reviews, external-facing presentations) and audiences (engineers, managers of managers, cross-functional teams).
- Comfort working in a fast-moving agile environment where every team member contributes across the full development lifecycle.

Nice to Have

- Experience in the gaming industry. If you haven’t worked in gaming but are passionate about building services that power games, we’d love to hear from you.

How You’ll Thrive At Skillz

- Customer obsessed: You think about the product and the customer first, and you approach work with a partnership mindset.
- Strategic thinker: You solve problems creatively and adapt as business needs change.
- Ownership: You care about the quality of your work and your team’s work, and you encourage the same in others.
- Execution: You deliver in a dynamic, agile environment and take responsibility end to end.
- Productive: You focus on results, not activity.
- Mission driven: You believe in making gaming better and bringing eSports to everyone.

Work Arrangement

This role is based in our Bengaluru office and requires working on-site 4 days a week.

Skillz embraces diversity and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As part of our commitment to diversifying our workforce, we do not discriminate on the basis of age, race, sex, gender, gender identity, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, marital status, citizenship, veteran status, or disability status, and we operate in compliance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

description:
Company: SCRY AI 
Location: Multiple 
Experience: 3+ year 
Employment Type: Full-time 

About Us 
SCRY AI is an innovative AI-driven technology company focused on building intelligent, scalable, and high-performance solutions. We work with modern technologies across Software Engineering, AI/ML, and Data to solve real-world business problems and deliver impactful digital products. 

Role Overview 
We are looking for a skilled Software Engineer – Python Backend with strong experience in building scalable APIs, backend services, and database-driven applications. The ideal candidate should be hands-on with Python, asynchronous programming, SQL, and API development, and comfortable working closely with UI/Frontend teams to deliver reliable end-to-end solutions. 

Key Responsibilities 
- Design, develop, and maintain scalable, high-performance backend applications using Python. 
- Build robust REST APIs and backend services using frameworks such as FastAPI or Flask. 
- Develop asynchronous and concurrent applications using asyncio, background workers, queues, and multiprocessing where required. 
- Design and optimize database schemas, SQL queries, joins, indexes, stored procedures, and transactions. 
- Work extensively with PostgreSQL/MySQL and other relational databases. 
- Collaborate with UI/Frontend teams on API contracts, request/response structures, authentication, error handling, and integration. 
- Build APIs capable of handling high traffic, concurrent requests, and real-time workloads. 
- Optimize API and database performance by identifying slow queries, bottlenecks, inefficient calls, and resource utilization issues. 
- Integrate backend services with third-party APIs, external systems, and enterprise applications. 
- Implement authentication, authorization, validation, logging, exception handling, and API security. 
- Write clean, reusable, maintainable, and well-documented code; develop unit/integration tests and participate in code reviews. 
- Containerize applications using Docker and support deployment, troubleshooting, monitoring, scalability, and reliability across environments. 

Key Qualifications
