title: Software Engineer - AI Tooling
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Engineer - AI Tooling based in India.

As a Software Engineer on the AI Tooling team, you will help shape the next generation of AI-powered developer experiences and tools.

You will design, build, and maintain intelligent agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, agent skills, and AI-powered assistants.

Your work will make development platforms and products more accessible to AI agents, enabling developers to build smarter applications and workflows.

You will champion an evaluation-first engineering approach, ensuring that every tool is measured against clear quality, reliability, and performance benchmarks.

Working closely with Documentation, CLI, Frontend, SDK, and Infrastructure teams, you will contribute to a consistent and scalable developer experience.

You will also explore emerging AI technologies, experiment with new approaches, and turn promising innovations into production-ready solutions.

This is an opportunity to make a significant impact in a fast-moving, open-source-oriented environment alongside a globally distributed engineering team.

Accountabilities

- Design, develop, and continuously improve AI-powered developer tools, including MCP servers, intelligent agents, agent skills, and dashboard assistants. 
- Ensure new products and features are accessible to AI agents from launch by developing the necessary tools, skills, integrations, and evaluation frameworks. 
- Explore emerging AI technologies and agent architectures, rapidly prototype new solutions, assess their effectiveness, and collaborate with the team to determine which innovations are suitable for production. 
- Establish and promote an evaluation-first engineering culture by developing evaluation frameworks, instrumentation, and feedback loops to measure AI tool quality and effectiveness. 
- Benchmark AI-powered tools against no-tool baselines, monitor performance, and define quality indicators and release criteria to prevent regressions. 
- Analyse how developers and AI agents interact with existing tools and translate usage insights into improvements to interfaces, documentation, and overall functionality. 
- Design and optimise how technical documentation and product knowledge are structured and exposed to AI agents, measuring their effectiveness and accessibility. 
- Develop reusable patterns and tools that enable customers to integrate AI capabilities into their own applications, including MCP integrations with Edge Functions, vector embeddings, and AI agents running on Edge Functions. 
- Enable cross-functional engineering teams to contribute to AI capabilities by providing clear contribution guidelines, templates, documentation, and review processes. 
- Centralise shared AI logic and reusable components to encourage consistency and reduce duplicated development efforts across teams. 
- Ensure production readiness through comprehensive testing, benchmarking, stress testing, and continuous reliability improvements. 
- Collaborate with AI Tooling Infrastructure engineers on service hosting, authentication, scalability, and operational reliability. 
- Work closely with Documentation, CLI, Frontend, SDK, and other engineering teams to deliver a seamless and consistent developer experience. 
- Stay informed about developments in the AI ecosystem and identify opportunities to incorporate relevant technologies and practices into the platform. 

Requirements

- At least 5 years of professional software engineering experience. 
- Strong proficiency in TypeScript and extensive knowledge of the JavaScript ecosystem, including npm, ES modules, bundlers, and compatibility considerations. 
- Deep familiarity with the AI ecosystem, including current tools, agent architectures, development patterns, and their practical trade-offs. 
- Ability to distinguish sustainable and effective AI engineering approaches from short-lived trends or unnecessary complexity. 
- Previous experience building developer tools, product interfaces, or platform components used by other engineers. 
- Experience designing, implementing, or working with evaluation frameworks to measure AI quality, reliability, and task success. 
- Understanding of evaluation fundamentals, including baselines, performance variance, cost considerations, and measurable quality improvements. 
- Strong technical judgment when identifying opportunities to use AI effectively while avoiding fragile, unnecessary, or overly complex solutions. 
- Solid testing practices and experience validating software reliability under real-world conditions. 
- Good knowledge of PostgreSQL and relational database principles. 
- Excellent written communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and documentation teams. 
- Comfortable working in asynchronous, globally distributed teams and managing priorities independently. 
- Ability to navigate ambiguity, adapt to rapidly evolving technologies, and deliver high-quality solutions in a fast-paced environment. 

Additional Experience That Would Be An Advantage

- Experience working with vector databases, embeddings, and semantic search technologies, particularly pgvector. 
- Previous experience shipping customer-facing AI features, intelligent assistants, or autonomous agents. 
- Experience designing technical documentation, structured knowledge bases, or information systems optimised for developers and AI agents. 
- Familiarity with Braintrust or similar AI evaluation and tracing platforms, or experience implementing automated quality gates within CI/CD pipelines. 
- Contributions to open-source projects or experience maintaining developer-focused tools and libraries. 
- Experience collaborating across multiple product areas, engineering teams, or technical platforms. 

Benefits

- Fully remote working environment, with the flexibility to work from anywhere in the world. 
- WeWork membership or co-working allowance to support access to a professional workspace. 
- Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP), giving every team member an opportunity to share in the organisation's long-term success. 
- Technology allowance to equip your home office with the hardware and tools you need, including laptops, monitors, and headphones. 
- Comprehensive health coverage, with 100% of employee health insurance costs covered and 80% of dependent coverage, wherever applicable.

- Flexible working hours within an asynchronous work culture that promotes autonomy and work-life balance. 
- Annual professional development and education allowance to invest in courses, books, conferences, and other learning opportunities. 
- Opportunity to work alongside a globally distributed team of approximately 400 professionals across more than 60 countries.

title: Software Development Engineer II, Amazon FinAuto - Travel & Events
description:
Description

The Amazon Travel & Events (AT&E) Tech team, part of Finance Automation, is driving a multi-year transformation of the end-to-end Travel & Expense experience for over 500,000 Amazon employees across 64 countries. We are consolidating previously fragmented travel, events, payments, and expense systems into a unified, AI-powered experience within AtoZ, organized around four interconnected modules: Plan, Book, Pay, and Expense. Our platform leverages machine learning, natural language processing, and GenAI to deliver context-aware policy guidance, proactive compliance recommendations, fraud detection, and sustainability intelligence embedded into employee workflows. The transformation eliminates significant administrative burden across the organization while delivering substantial cost savings and recovering employee productivity at scale.

We are seeking a passionate Software Development Engineer who can help us build the next generation of unified Travel & Expense systems and support the AT&E organization.

As a Software Development Engineer on the team, you will design and build services that power AI-driven policy guidance, intelligent booking experiences, automated expense workflows, centralized payment mechanisms, and real-time T&E analytics serving a global customer base. You will collaborate with product managers, data scientists, and senior and peer-level software engineers across Finance Automation and partner organizations including Accounts Payable and Global Corporate Procurement. This role provides you with autonomy and ownership over decisions, working backwards directly from customers. There is ample opportunity for growth due to the high-visibility work and presence of senior engineering talent for guidance and mentorship. The team operates in cross-functional two-pizza team structures that lead T&E technical transformations.

You will contribute to a three-tier AI architecture that answers employee policy questions in under 2 seconds with source references, and proactively surfaces policy-compliant recommendations during booking to prevent violations before they occur. You will build modern, mobile-first travel booking and Meetings & Events hub experiences across 45+ countries with real-time validation and calendar integration. You will develop guided workflows, automated data integration pipelines, and conversational agents that significantly reduce expense report submission time and eliminate a meaningful share of expense reports entirely. You will build virtual payment capabilities and central card automation that reduce out-of-pocket employee spend and target zero manual reconciliation. You will develop AI/ML-powered fraud detection models that automate the majority of investigation checks and support transaction-based detection across expanding payment avenues. You will build a single-source T&E analytics platform providing real-time spend insights, policy violation tracking, and cost optimization visibility for managers and finance partners.

Key job responsibilities

- Design and implement scalable service architectures that power AI-driven policy guidance, intelligent booking, and automated expense workflows for a global user base.
- Deliver working features across the full software development lifecycle, from requirements and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and operations.
- Collaborate with product managers, applied scientists, and engineers across Finance Automation and partner organizations to translate business needs into reliable technical solutions.
- Coach teammates through code reviews and design discussions, raising the quality bar for the team's software and establishing shared engineering best practices.
- Identify and resolve root causes of operational issues while continuously improving system reliability and maintainability.

About The Team

The Amazon Travel and Events Tech team sits within Finance Automation and is on a multi-year mission to unify how Amazon employees plan, book, pay for, and expense business travel and events worldwide. We are a collaborative, inclusive group of engineers, product managers, and scientists who value clear thinking and pragmatic design. If you want to build products at global scale that make a tangible difference in how people work, we would love to hear from you.

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

- Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers

Preferred Qualifications

description:
Lead Full-Stack Engineer

  

**Company:** EduBridge Learning Pvt. Ltd.  
**Department:** Product & Learning Solutions  
**Location:** Mumbai (Work from Office)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time, Permanent  
**Experience:** 812 Years  
**Reporting To:** President Product & Learning Solutions

  

About EduBridge

EduBridge Learning is one of India's leading workforce skilling companies, focused on empowering young people through education, skill development and career opportunities.

Our Product & Learning Solutions team builds technology-driven products that support learning and career progression, including AI-powered language learning applications, job readiness assessment platforms, international career platforms and career services tools.

  

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced **Lead Full-Stack Engineer** to lead the architecture, development and deployment of a new AI-powered product from the ground up.

The individual will be responsible for end-to-end product engineering, including backend and frontend development, system architecture, database design, AI integrations and cloud deployment.

This role requires a hands-on technical leader who can independently drive development, establish engineering standards, mentor junior developers and collaborate closely with product leadership.

Key Responsibilities

1. Technical Architecture & Product Development

* Design and develop scalable product architecture, including services, APIs, databases and deployment environments.
* Translate product requirements into technical specifications, development plans and timelines.
* Lead end-to-end development from initial architecture to production deployment.
* Develop and maintain core backend, frontend and integration modules.
* Ensure product scalability, performance, reliability and maintainability.

2. Full-Stack Development

* Develop backend applications using Node.js or Python.
* Build responsive frontend applications using React or Next.js.
* Design and optimise PostgreSQL databases, including schema design, queries and performance.
* Implement multi-tenant SaaS architecture with row-level security.
* Work with Supabase or equivalent backend platforms.

3. Engineering Standards & Code Quality

* Establish coding standards, development guidelines and technical documentation.
* Conduct code reviews and ensure code quality before deployment.
* Implement automated testing, CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes.
* Set up production monitoring, debugging and performance optimisation.
* Ensure application security and data privacy, including compliance with applicable data protection requirements.

4. AI & Third-Party Integrations

* Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs), AI APIs, speech and voice technologies into production applications.
* Develop reliable and scalable AI-powered product features.
* Integrate third-party APIs, platforms and external data sources.
* Monitor AI performance, usage and operational costs.

5. Team Leadership & Mentoring

* Mentor junior developers and interns through technical guidance, code reviews and hands-on collaboration.
* Break down development requirements into manageable tasks.
* Guide developers on coding practices, debugging and implementation.
* Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, quality and timely delivery.

6. Product & Stakeholder Collaboration

* Work closely with product managers, designers and business stakeholders.
* Participate in sprint planning, weekly product reviews and product demonstrations.
* Track development progress and highlight technical risks.
* Ensure timely delivery of product milestones and releases.

  

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 812 years of hands-on Full-Stack Development experience.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in a Tech Lead / Lead Engineer role.
* Proven experience building and launching at least one product from scratch to production.
* Strong backend development expertise in Node.js or Python.
* Strong frontend development experience in React or Next.js.
* Extensive experience with PostgreSQL, database architecture and optimisation.
* Hands-on experience with multi-tenant SaaS architecture and row-level security.
* Experience integrating AI / LLM APIs into live products.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, system architecture and third-party integrations.
* Experience with cloud deployment, CI/CD pipelines, testing and production monitoring.
* Strong technical leadership, problem-solving and mentoring capabilities.

  

Good to Have

* Experience in EdTech, HRTech or B2B SaaS products.
* Experience with AI-powered applications and LLM-based solutions.
* Exposure to speech, voice and real-time audio integrations.
* Experience with React Native or Flutter.
* Knowledge of India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act.
* Experience developing analytics dashboards and reporting platforms.
* Familiarity with Linear, Jira or similar project management tools.

  

First 90-Day Deliverables

* **First 30 Days:** Understand product requirements, evaluate existing systems and finalise the technical architecture and engineering roadmap.
* **First 60 Days:** Develop core modules in a staging environment and establish code review, testing and deployment standards.
* **First 90 Days:** Drive the first product release and enable junior developers to independently deliver features under technical supervision.

  

**Education**

B.E. / B.Tech / MCA in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline.

  

Application Process

Interested candidates can share their updated resume, GitHub profile or links to products they have developed or led.

title: GPU Software Development Engineer
description:
****Job Details:******Job Description:** 

**The Role and Impact:**

  

As a GPU Software Development Engineer, you will focus on enabling and optimizing Intel's GPUs by developing, backporting, and validating software solutions that span the stack-from firmware and device drivers to APIs and the application layer. You will play a critical role in designing, debugging, and improving GPU kernel drivers and graphics software on Linux platforms across diverse kernel environments and enterprise distributions, ensuring seamless integration and performance. Your contributions will directly support Intel's innovations in graphics and data center technologies.

**Business Group:**

The Data Center Group (DCG) drives Intel's leadership in computing innovation, with a focus on delivering high-performance solutions for data-centric markets. This group develops technologies that power advanced workloads in cloud computing, AI, and graphics acceleration. By joining DCG, you'll collaborate with experts dedicated to enabling cutting-edge GPU solutions that advance Intel's broader mission to shape the future of technology.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Develop and validate GPU kernel drivers and graphics software solutions, contributing to the full development lifecycle from design and implementation to testing and release across Linux platforms, including contributions to the open-source graphics software community where applicable.
* Debug, optimize, and enable Linux DRM/KMD drivers - including root cause analysis of kernel panics, regressions, deadlocks, race conditions, and memory corruption across diverse hardware and software environments.
* Design and implement new driver features, enhancements, and optimizations within the Linux DRM/KMD subsystem, collaborating closely with hardware and firmware teams to enable new GPU capabilities.
* Adapt and backport upstream Intel GPU drivers (DRM/KMD) to LTS, enterprise, and customized customer kernel environments, designing and maintaining compatibility layers and out-of-tree packaging solutions such as DKMS.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams - spanning firmware, KMD, user-space runtime, and compute/graphics stacks - to ensure robust integration, compatibility, and stability across the full GPU software stack.
* Partner with validation and DevOps teams to expand multi-kernel test matrices, regression suites, and automated build pipelines that catch compatibility breaks early.
* Ensure high code quality and adherence to Linux kernel coding standards through active participation in design and code reviews, spanning both upstream driver development and backported driver deliverables.

****Qualifications:****

**Minimum Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Electronics/Electrical Engineering.  
  5+ years of hands-on experience in large-scale software product development with deep focus on Linux kernel and system software engineering.
* Expert-level C programming with deep understanding of Linux kernel internals, driver architecture, memory management, concurrency, locking primitives, and interrupt handling.
* Proven experience developing and debugging Linux DRM/KMD drivers and device driver debugging mechanisms.
* Hands-on experience backporting Linux kernel patches and drivers across kernel versions, with practical understanding of kernel API/ABI drift and compatibility wrapper construction.
* Proficiency in Linux kernel debugging tools such as ftrace, perf, kdump/crash, kgdb, GDB, dynamic debug, and interpreting stack traces and lockdep reports.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Electronics/Electrical Engineering.
* Deep experience with Linux DRM/KMS subsystem, GPU memory management (TTM, GEM), DMA-BUF, and modern graphics/compute software stacks.
* Experience with out-of-tree module frameworks (DKMS, Kbuild backport frameworks) and multi-kernel distribution packaging (RPM, DEB).
* Experience triaging and resolving kernel regressions caused by upstream changes in core subsystems such as schedulers, memory allocators, power management, and PCIe buses.
* Experience supporting customer-specific or enterprise Linux distributions such as RHEL, SLES, or Ubuntu LTS, including kernel validation and issue resolution in production environments.
* Active patch submissions or contributions to the open-source Linux kernel or DRM/graphics community.

  

Join us to work on impactful projects that shape the future of GPU technology and advance Intel's mission of delivering world-changing innovations.

description:
**Senior Software Engineer**

The job responsibilities outlined in this document are not exhaustive and may evolve over time and be reviewed according to business needs.

**ROLE DESCRIPTION SUMMARY**

SES has an exciting opportunity for a Senior Engineer. You will be part of a team responsible for

* Portal software design, governing scalable architectural improvements along with team productivity, scalability, simplification and quality improvements
* Driving architectural alignment and long-term technical strategy across multiple teams.
* Leading feature refinements and ensuring end-to-end delivery of high-quality, reliable solutions.
* Enabling predictable delivery through strong architectural judgment and technical mentorship.
* Ensuring long-term maintainability, operational excellence, and system health.
* Partnering closely with product, platform, and external stakeholders to deliver scalable solutions.
* Leading the team using Agile principles to ensure clarity, focus, and delivery alignment
* Preparing and guiding the team through PI Planning and sprint commitments
* Maintaining hands-on involvement in coding, design, and problem-solving
* Guiding the team in following best coding standards, engineering practices and effective use of AI
* Improving team productivity, code quality, and technical excellence

  

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY RESULT AREAS**

The ideal candidate will be a hands-on technical leader and key contributor within an engineering team, responsible for designing and delivering scalable, high-quality software solutions. The role requires strong expertise in system architecture, application design, performance optimization, CI/CD practices, and modern software development methodologies. The candidate will provide architectural direction, guide technical design and implementation, mentor engineering teams, and drive Agile execution to ensure predictable, high-quality delivery of business outcomes. Primary Responsibilities will include the following.

**Core Responsibilities**

* **Technical Leadership & Solution Architecture:** Provide hands-on technical leadership while defining scalable, maintainable, and resilient solution architectures that align with business objectives, enterprise standards, and long-term technology strategy.
* **Requirement Analysis & Feature Refinement:** Partner with Product Owners, Architects, QA, and stakeholders to refine requirements, assess technical feasibility, define solution scope, identify dependencies, and drive end-to-end feature delivery.
* **Hands-on Engineering & Design:** Actively contribute to solution design, development, debugging, and technical problem-solving while guiding the team in delivering high-quality software solutions.
* **Architecture Governance & Engineering Standards:** Establish and enforce architecture principles, design patterns, coding standards, CI/CD practices, and AI-assisted engineering practices through design reviews, code reviews, and technical governance.
* **Quality, Performance & Operational Excellence:** Ensure solutions meet quality, security, scalability, reliability, observability, and performance expectations while driving production readiness and post-release stability.
* **Cross-Team Collaboration & Integration:** Collaborate with architecture, platform, DevOps, QA, product teams, vendors, and other engineering teams to align technical direction, manage integration contracts, and ensure seamless delivery.
* **Risk, Dependency & Delivery Management:** Identify and proactively mitigate technical risks, architectural challenges, cross-team dependencies, and delivery impediments to ensure predictable execution.
* **Mentorship & Technical Capability Development:** Coach and mentor engineers, foster technical excellence, strengthen engineering practices, and drive Communities of Practice (CoP) to promote continuous learning and knowledge sharing.
* **Agile Delivery & Continuous Improvement:** Lead technical execution within Agile teams by improving estimation accuracy, delivery predictability, engineering productivity, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* **Innovation & Technology Enablement:** Evaluate and adopt modern technologies, architectural patterns, automation, and AI-driven development practices to improve engineering efficiency and accelerate business value delivery.

  

**Key Focus Areas**

* **Portal System Software:** Drive scalable, observable, high-quality software development and delivery.
* **Team-Level Software Delivery:** Drive high-quality, maintainable, and reliable software development within the team, ensuring timely and predictable delivery aligned with sprint and PI objectives.
* **Implementation Excellence:** Ensure solutions are designed and implemented with strong emphasis on code quality, testability, reusability, and adherence to engineering best practices.
* **Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs):** Ensuring the system is fully monitored, reliable, secure, performant, and maintainable.
* **Operational Readiness:** Support production readiness by incorporating monitoring, logging, resiliency, and supportability considerations into development.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Drive ongoing improvements in development practices, Agile execution, team productivity, and technical maturity.

**COMPETENCIES**

* **Communication**: Clearly articulates complex technical concepts through concise documentation and presentations, effectively influencing stakeholders, customers, and vendors.
* **Architectural Judgment & Problem Solving:** Demonstrates strong analytical thinking to evaluate trade-offs, drive sound decisions, and resolve complex technical challenges.
* **Technical Leadership & Collaboration:** Leads with ownership while working autonomously and collaborating effectively across cross-functional, matrixed teams.

**QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**

* Master’s or bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology or related technology – advanced degree preferred.
* Minimum 12+ years of experience in the software industry, including 2+ years as a Technical Lead and 2+ years as an Architect, along with 5+ years of hands-on experience designing and building scalable APIs and microservices.
* Good development experience with Java / Spring Boot / Go / Node.js / NGINX / Rabbit MQ
* Nice to have development experience in React.js
* Good experience in Architecting and Designing Large scale applications
* Experience in CI/CD and AWS deployments (EC2, SQS, SNS, Lambda, S3, Aurora, DynamoDB)
* Strong experience with system observability, monitoring and production support.
* Advanced knowledge of software development lifecycles; expert knowledge in Agile and Lean methods.
* Ability to support architectural suggestions and bring up a high available and scalable system.
* Ability to work under pressure, prioritize work, coordinate with onsite stakeholders and well organized.
* Flexibility in working with technologies and platforms.
* A commitment to excellence, best practices, and the continuous improvement of our products, code base, processes, and tools.

title: Lead Full-Stack Engineer
description:
Location: Worli, Mumbai (On-site)

Own the technical roadmap across both our marketplace and SaaS products.

Build and optimize backend services — APIs, database design, performance, security.

Make infrastructure decisions on AWS, Docker, and deployment pipelines that can scale with us.

Set code quality standards through reviews, documentation, and hands-on mentorship with the team.

Work closely with the founders and designers to translate product ideas into well-engineered features.

Identify and fix bottlenecks before they become crises — and debug them fast when they do.

Be the person who asks "why are we building this?" before asking "how?"

The Stack

React · Next.js · Node.js · PostgreSQL · Flutter · AWS · Docker

We don't do rewrites for fun. You'll be working with and improving an existing production codebase — so strong opinions, loosely held, matter more than preferences.

What We're Looking For

3-7 years of strong full-stack engineering experience, with real ownership over architecture and product decisions.

Hands-on expertise across the stack: Next.js on the frontend, Node.js/Express on the backend, PostgreSQL for data, AWS + Docker for infra.

Experience with or a serious willingness to go deep on Flutter — this is non-negotiable given where we're headed.

A track record of leading or meaningfully mentoring other engineers.

Strong product instincts — you understand that good code that solves the wrong problem is still bad engineering.

A strong technical foundation; we have a lot of respect for people who came up through rigorous CS programs (IITs, NITs, and equivalents), though we care more about what you've built and how you think.

Experience in a startup or early-stage product environment — or a very clear reason why you're ready for one.

Who You Are

You're probably a few years into a solid engineering career and starting to feel like you want more than just tickets to close. You want to own something. You want to make calls. You want to build a team and see it get better over time.

You write code that your future self won't be embarrassed by, and you expect the same from the people around you. You can jump between Flutter and Next.js in the same week without losing context. You've debugged things in production at midnight and learned something from it.

You know the difference between over-engineering and building to scale — and you can explain that difference clearly to someone who's never thought about it.

And honestly? You're excited about the problem. PG rentals and property management in India are genuinely broken, and you see the opportunity in fixing the infrastructure layer underneath them.

What We Offer

A real technical leadership role with full ownership over architecture and engineering culture.

Work directly with the founding team — short feedback loops, fast decisions, no bureaucracy.

An already live platform with real users, so you're building on something real — not starting from zero.

Competitive CTC for the stage we're at, with a possibility of equity.

On-site in Worli, Mumbai — we work together in person.

The kind of career acceleration that only comes from being early at a company that's going somewhere.

Interested can share resume on piyusha@mittalpalms.com

Pay: ₹1,000,000.00 - ₹1,300,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Sr. Software Engineer - Agentic Flows
description:
**Job Description**

**Location: Kochi or Bangalore, India (Hybrid)**  
**Type: Permanent - Full Time**

**About Us**

Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400+ employees and 70,000+ customers across 100+ countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end-to-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen & Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass & Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North & South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.
  
Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end-to-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.
  
Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specializing in technology.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a Sr AI/ML Engineer to build agentic front ends for our products. Most of our products currently offer UI based interaction to our customers. Given the complexity involved in the flows, traditional UI based interaction needs training for users before they can develop desired proficiency in the product. We want to build NLP based interactive UIs where AI agents make flows not only easier to learn but also provide suggestive inputs to aid design process. This role will attempt at revolutionizing UI/UX for our customers by offering them a guided flow and thereby eliminating learning curve needed for understanding complex design process.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and implement agentic workflows in the frontend (multi-step AI-driven user journeys)
* Oversee development of UI components that interact with LLMs, APIs and agent orchestration layer
* Handle state management to ensure proper context is available LLMs to provide decision support
* Translate complex backend agent logic to clear, user-friendly interfaces
* Implement real-time interactions (chat interfaces, copilots (AI based kitchen designing), suggestions, searches etc.)
* Ensure performance, scalability, and responsiveness of AI-powered UI flows
* Contribute to design systems that support AI-native UX patterns
* Write clean, maintainable, production-ready code with strong software design principles, testing, and code reviews

**Tool Evaluation & Strategy**

* Define standards and guidelines for appropriate AI tool usage for building agentic flows
* Stay current with emerging AI tools and capabilities relevant for building real-time agentic interactions
* Work with engineering/product leadership to develop strategy and roadmap
* Monitor tool effectiveness and ROI, providing data-driven recommendations for tool selection and renewal

**Required Qualifications**

**AI/ML & Agentic Experience**

* Overall 5+ years of experience in developing AI based solutions with 4+ years of experience in working with LLMs (openAI, Anthropic etc)
* Exposure to agentic frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, etc.)
* Experience in building chat-based or AI-assisted interfaces and Agent UI Protocols including JSON based UI rendering
* Understanding of prompt design and AI interaction patterns
* Knowledge of event-driven architecture and persistent state management in agentic loops
* Familiarity with tool calling / function calling paradigms
* Familiarity with setting up MCP and multi-agent interactions
* Knowledge of RAG based solutions and text-mining to find insights from chat histories
* Hands-on experience with Agent-to-Agent protocols and communication patterns

**Software Engineering & Core Technical Skills**

* Strong proficiency in modern programming languages (Python, TypeScript/JavaScript)
* Hands-on experience with modern frontend frameworks (React, Next.js, or Vue.js) for building dynamic, stateful UIs
* Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs, WebSockets, or Server-Sent Events (SSE) for streaming AI responses
* Strong software engineering fundamentals (Data Structures, Algorithms, Object-Oriented/Functional Programming, System Design)
* Familiarity with containerization (Docker) and basic CI/CD pipeline integration for deploying AI microservices

**Soft Skills**

* Experience in leading teams building AI/ML embedded products
* Ability to work in ambiguous, fast-evolving AI spaces
* Clear communication with cross-functional teams

**Working for Us**

At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills - and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.

Here, you’ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. You’ll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth.

We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone - from every background - to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together.

If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in - Come join us.

title: Front-End Engineer, Website Platform
description:
**About MyAdvice** 
**MyAdvice is an established, profitable company with a long history in the markets we serve. We have made a fast, deep shift toward AI-enabled solutions and operate with the urgency and standards of a startup. We are fast-moving and aggressive. We need results-oriented people on our team who will never be satisfied with the status quo and will work hard toward continuous improvement.**


What we do. MyAdvice provides an AI-powered system that reduces manual work and cost while helping clients grow revenue. The Success Center, powered by Mya, unifies growth activity across channels and automates workflow execution.

Our mission. We make it easy to profitably grow your business.

How we work. GREAT means Gritty, Resourceful, Expert, Accountable, and Tenacious. We expect hard work, extreme ownership, and extreme accountability. We are willing to do the difficult work required to deliver exceptional outcomes for our clients and our colleagues.“We are going to relentlessly chase perfection, knowing full well we will not catch it, because nothing is perfect. But we are going to chase it because, in the process, we will catch excellence.” — Vince Lombardi  
  
**The opportunity**  
We're hiring the front-end owner of a new website platform: the engineer responsible for everything a client, a marketer and a patient actually see and touch.  
  
MyAdvice powers the websites of thousands of medical, dental and legal practices. Today those sites live on a fragmented legacy stack, each one built and patched by hand. We're replacing all of it with one platform built on Next.js and Payload, where a new client site is provisioned in minutes, and we're building a generative AI pipeline that will design, lay out and populate it.  
  
The back end of that platform has owners: multi-tenancy, the data model, provisioning and infrastructure. What it needs now is someone who owns the experience layer as seriously as they do. That means the editor people build pages in, the component library every site is assembled from, the theming system that makes each site look bespoke from one codebase, and the rendering and performance work that decides whether those sites get found.  
  
Two things make this job unusual, and you should know both before you apply.  
  
We are building our own editor, not configuring someone else's. Payload's admin is built for developers, and there is no client-ready page builder we can drop in. We evaluated the off-the-shelf options and decided against them. So the editor is ours to build, over Payload's native blocks schema, working inside the framework's admin internals. This is the deep end of Payload, and it is the hardest and most consequential front-end work on the platform. Thousands of practice staff who use Elementor, Divi or Gutenberg today will land in what you build.  
  
The AI generates configuration, never code. One framework, one component set, unlimited variation through data. The pipeline emits schema-validated JSON: a token set, a section composition, per-block style properties. Your component library and token system are the vocabulary that output is written in, which means the quality ceiling of every generated site is set by what you build.  
  
Every improvement you make ships to every site at once. A 200ms LCP win is not one page, it is the whole fleet.  
  
You'd join a small, Website Platform team: a platform engineer on the application and infrastructure layer, a full-stack builder, a senior architect who knows our existing systems deeply and advises across the project, and our AI engineering group on the generation pipeline. You'd report to our VP of Engineering.  
  
**What you'll own**

* The editor. Our own editing experience, built over Payload's native blocks schema, that non-technical marketers and delivery staff can move fast in without being able to break a site. Drag and drop, live preview, undo, validation, and guardrails that hold. This is product engineering inside a framework's internals, and it is the centre of this role.
* The component library. The blocks every site is assembled from: heroes, provider directories, location maps, before-and-after galleries, review carousels, forms. Typed, accessible, tested, documented, and composable enough that the AI pipeline can assemble them as reliably as a person can.
* The theming system. One codebase, per-tenant design tokens, genuinely distinct sites, zero per-tenant code. You'll own the token vocabulary and the mechanism that applies it. You'll also hold the line that keeps it working: tokens rather than per-block overrides, no escape hatch for custom CSS, new variants earning their place through review rather than accumulating.
* Rendering and performance. The Next.js App Router rendering strategy, covering server components, static generation, caching and revalidation, and Core Web Vitals across the whole fleet. You measure before you claim, and you set the performance budgets that keep new work from regressing.
* SEO in the markup. Semantic HTML, metadata, and valid schema.org structured data for practices, providers and locations. These sites exist to be found.
* Accessibility. WCAG 2.1 AA as a floor, not an aspiration. Healthcare websites serve patients of every ability, accessibility failures are a legal risk for our clients, and contrast and a11y checks are a gate that generated output has to pass before it ships.
* Rendering what the AI generates. The pipeline produces a layout and content as data. Your components and editor turn that into a site a practice will put its name on. You'll work with our AI engineers on the contract between the two, and make sure a generated page can always be opened, understood and fixed by a person.
* Handling patient media correctly. Before-and-after imagery is protected health information, and it flows through the upload path and gallery components you build. You'll be responsible for getting consent state, access control and provenance right in the front end, with our architect and compliance work behind you.
* The front-end quality bar. Testing strategy covering unit, component, visual regression and end-to-end, front-end CI checks, code review standards, and the patterns the rest of the team follows.

**What you'll work within**  
Two constraints are worth stating plainly, because they shape the work and we would rather you know now.  
The page schema is frozen early and deliberately. It is the one commitment on this platform that is expensive to reverse, so it gets locked in the first phase and changes after that are rare and deliberate. You'll be building a large component library inside a schema you cannot casually reshape.  
We also expect to work with an external build partner during the build phase, who will contribute code and then exit. Part of this role is reviewing what they produce and owning it afterwards, which is a real responsibility and also a fast way to see the whole surface of the platform.  
  
**What we're looking for**

* We care about what you have shipped and can show us, not what is listed in your skills section. Specifically:
* 5+ years building production front ends, with React and TypeScript as your daily tools. You've shipped and maintained real applications, not prototypes.
* Next.js in production, ideally the App Router. You can explain when you'd render on the server, statically or on the client, and you've lived with the caching consequences.
* You've built custom editing or admin UI inside a framework you didn't write. Payload admin components, Sanity Studio customisation, Strapi admin plugins, a custom canvas over a CMS data model, or comparable depth elsewhere. We want evidence you can work inside someone else's framework internals rather than only on top of a clean API. This is the requirement we weigh most heavily.
* You've built a component library or design system that other engineers used. You've designed component APIs, versioned them, documented them, and dealt with the requests to bend them.
* You've rendered UI from data. Server-driven UI, a block or schema-based renderer, layouts described as JSON rather than written as JSX. You understand what makes a component set composable by a machine rather than only by a person.
* Measured performance work. You've moved a Core Web Vital, whether LCP, INP or CLS, and can tell us the before, the after, and what you changed.
* Accessibility you can demonstrate. Keyboard navigation, focus management, ARIA used correctly, and testing with real assistive technology, not just a passing Lighthouse score.
* You test your front end. Component tests with Jest or Vitest and Testing Library, plus end-to-end or visual regression tests with Playwright, Cypress or similar, are part of how you ship.
* Enough back end to be dangerous. You're comfortable reading and writing Node.js and working against a headless CMS or API, even if the server isn't your main job.
* You raise the bar around you. Code review, patterns, documentation, mentoring.
* AI-native. You use Cursor, Claude or similar to build faster, and you own the judgment about what is safe to ship to a live fleet.
* Overlap with US colleagues. Comfortable working 2pm to 11pm IST with real-time collaboration.

**Things that would make us especially excited**

* Payload specifically, or depth in another headless CMS such as Strapi, Sanity, Contentful or Directus.
* You've built a page builder, a visual canvas, or editing tools used by non-technical people at scale.
* Design-token systems or theming engines serving many brands from one codebase.
* Schema.org structured data and technical SEO at scale.
* Experience with regulated or sensitive media, whether HIPAA, consent management, or access-controlled assets.
* Migrating sites off WordPress or another legacy stack.
* Integrating LLM-generated content or layouts into a real product.
* Open-source front-end contributions we can read.

Missing several of these is fine. Depth in the fundamentals, and evidence you've owned something real, matter more than a full checklist.  
  
**How we hire**  
A short written assessment and a recorded walkthrough of front-end code you're proud of, in your own words.  
A conversation with our VP of Engineering about what you've built and how you think.  
A technical session with the team: a front-end exercise in TypeScript and React, and a discussion of how you'd approach the editor and theming problems.  
We move quickly and tell every candidate where they stand.  
  
**Position Details**  
Compensation: Open to discussion  
Position Type: Full-time  
Work Location: Bangalore (Bengaluru), India  
Travel: May require occasional local or nation travel (less than 5% of the time, if at all).  
Physical Requirements: Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer (90% at desk, 10% of time walking); Ability to lift up to 30lbs and use typical office equipment (computer, keyboards, printer, etc.).  
  
**Benefits**  
Employer contributed medical insurance (100% premium covered by the company)  
Provident Fund (PF) contributions as per policy  
Leave Policy: 12 Sick/Casual Leaves + 18 Annual Leaves + 10 Company Holidays  
Flexible Schedules + Early Out Fridays!  
Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Free mental health support, financial/legal consultations and more  
Tuition Reimbursement Program (up to 1 lakh annually) + Executive Mentorship Program  
Ongoing personalized coaching and career development support  
Casual Dress (non-client facing roles) and Fun Work Environment  
Weekly Core Value Award, Project Fantastic (client collaboration) and more!

title: Software Engineer 3 - GenAI
description:
About Bidgely

Bidgely is a Silicon Valley AI company transforming how utilities and their customers understand and manage energy. The UtilityAI platform converts smart meter data into appliance-level insights, while Agentic CX brings GenAI assistants to utility chat, voice IVR, and customer service. Leading utilities across North America, Europe, and Asia rely on Bidgely. Our Bengaluru engineering center is a certified Great Place to Work.

The Role

We are seeking a senior software engineer to build and scale Energy Assistant, our GenAI assistant embedded in utility web portals and mobile apps. Energy Assistant answers customers' questions about usage, bills, appliances, rate plans, and savings through a multi-agent system built on LangGraph, leveraging Bidgely's energy data with tool calls and deterministic calculations. You will own major components end to end, help shape the architecture, and elevate the engineering standards of the team. This is a hands-on role working closely with GenAI engineering, platform, QA/SDET, and product teams.

Key Responsibilities

* Design and build production multi-agent systems: supervisor/router and specialist agents, LangGraph workflows, tool calling, conversation memory, and checkpointing.
* Build typed tool contracts and data-access layers over Bidgely APIs to ensure the LLM explains results instead of generating numbers.
* Develop RAG pipelines for utility tariff and knowledge retrieval, with tenant-isolated embeddings and retrieval.
* Manage latency, reliability, and cost: caching, prewarming, retries, circuit breakers, and model routing across small and large model tiers.
* Implement guardrails for prompt injection, scope control, authorization, tenant isolation, and data management.
* Build observability and evaluation hooks with LangSmith, and collaborate with SDETs on evaluation datasets, regression suites, and release criteria.
* Debug agent failures in production using traces, logs, and metrics, and drive root-cause fixes.
* Support streaming (WebSocket/SSE) and widget integration with front-end teams.
* Lead design and code reviews, set engineering standards, and mentor SDE1 and SDE2 engineers.
* Communicate designs, trade-offs, and progress to engineering, product, and leadership.

Requirements

* 6–10 years of software engineering experience, including at least 1–2 years building and shipping LLM or GenAI features in production.
* Strong Python skills and good working knowledge of Java.
* Hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or similar agent orchestration frameworks.
* Experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Amazon Bedrock), prompt design, tool/function calling, and structured outputs.
* Experience building RAG systems with embeddings and vector stores (e.g., pgvector).
* Strong backend and API design skills, with experience building scalable, low-latency services.
* Experience with AWS, containers (EKS), PostgreSQL, Redis, and CI/CD.
* Experience with evals, LLM-as-judge, or AI observability tools such as LangSmith.
* Strong system design, analytical, and communication skills.

Nice to Have

* Experience with time-series, IoT, or smart meter data, or the energy and utilities domain.
* Experience with voice or IVR GenAI products.
* Experience with multi-tenant SaaS solutions, security, and data-privacy enhancements for LLM applications.

Tech You Will Work With

Python, Java, LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, OpenAI, Anthropic, Amazon Bedrock, RAG, pgvector, tool calling, agent guardrails, REST APIs, WebSocket/SSE, PostgreSQL (RDS), Redis, AWS (EKS), ELK, and CI/CD.
